snippet.title: AI-Built Retro FPS (Godot) — Possession & Keycard Doors | Devlog #3
snippet.description:
💖 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3876620/Crimson_System_VD_Protocol/ — and join the Discord: https://discord.com/invite/BV6mrpDCnp

What’s new in this build
• Fixed a performance hit: door terminals were playing 4K videos; downscaled for now, higher-quality animations will return.
• Added classic colored doors + keycards (eye = goodies, skull = danger).
• Possession is needed to access locked areas; vision shifts and audio gets slightly muffled inside a host.
• Plus: save cubes, ammo pickups, level layout pass; mini-boss room placeholder.
• Context: I’m not a game-dev by background — this project explores how far you can go using AI tools to realize your own ideas.
